home.placeholder: This page is a placeholder - it is not yet connected to real pipeline runs (PLAN.md §6.16 is requirements/prototype only).

composer.title: Pipeline Composer
composer.canvasEmptyHint: Drag a tool from the palette onto the canvas to add it to your pipeline.
composer.saveHint: Downloads a JSON snapshot of the current canvas (nodes, connections, positions, parameters).
composer.runDisabledHint: Not connected to the pipeline yet - this button is a placeholder.
composer.noParams: No configurable parameters for this tool yet.
composer.skippedTooltip: Skipped - this stage will not run.
composer.autoArrangeHint: Arranges nodes into rows based on their connections, top to bottom.
composer.importHint: Loads a previously saved pipeline JSON file, replacing the current canvas.

importError.invalid-json: That file isn't valid JSON and couldn't be read.
importError.malformed: That file isn't a valid pipeline snapshot (missing or malformed fields).
importError.unsupported-version: That file was saved in a format this version of the composer doesn't understand.
importError.unknown-tool: That file references a tool that doesn't exist in this pipeline's catalog.

kraken2.ramAutoHint: Auto-detected via your browser - capped at 8 GB and only a rough estimate, since browsers deliberately don't expose your machine's exact RAM. Edit this if you know your actual total.
kraken2.ramManualHint: Your browser doesn't support automatic RAM detection - enter your machine's total RAM manually.

history.title: Run History
history.placeholder: No run has completed yet. Once a run finishes on the Run Pipeline page, its report will show up here automatically.

metaspades.name: metaSPAdes
metaspades.description: Alternative de novo assembler, more accurate but slower.

kraken2.name: Kraken2
kraken2.description: Taxonomic classification against a reference database.

bracken.name: Bracken
bracken.description: Re-estimates abundance from a Kraken2 report.

genomad.name: geNomad
genomad.description: Identifies viral and plasmid sequences in contigs.

checkv.name: CheckV
checkv.description: Grades completeness and contamination of viral genomes.

maxbin2.name: MaxBin2
maxbin2.description: Groups contigs into per-organism genome bins.

multiqc.name: MultiQC
multiqc.description: Aggregates every tool's output into one report.

pavian.name: Pavian
pavian.description: Interactive viewer for exploring Kraken2/Bracken taxonomic reports.

viral.name: Viral
viral.description: RefSeq viral genomes only - tiny, good for smoke-testing pipeline mechanics, not for real classification of bacterial samples.

standard_08_GB.name: Standard (8 GB)
standard_08_GB.description: Archaea, bacteria, viral, plasmid, human, UniVec, capped to an 8 GB hash table. This project's own real truth-validation database.

standard_16_GB.name: Standard (16 GB)
standard_16_GB.description: Same content as Standard (8 GB), capped larger for better accuracy. Documented production candidate.

pluspf_16_GB.name: PlusPF (16 GB)
pluspf_16_GB.description: Standard content plus protozoa and fungi, same 16 GB cap - recommended for animal-derived samples.
